title: Summit 2026 - travel & expense reminders (scratchpad)
summary: Working scratchpad for Summit 2026 travel logistics, vendor contacts, and expense submission reminders. Mostly notes-to-self and action items for Jordan + ops collaborators.
content:
PURPOSE: personal/admin scratchpad for Summit 2026 (on-site booth + 1 talk). Use as single source for quick reminders, vendors, receipts, and who-does-what. Informal notes; will migrate key items to Confluence once finalized.

TRAVEL LOGISTICS (quick):
- Flights (booked on corporate card): LAX -> SFO, AA 256, depart 2026-04-12 07:00 local, return 2026-04-15 20:40 local. Keep boarding passes (screen caps ok).
- Hotel: Grand City Hotel, reservation under Redwood Inference (block: REDWOOD-42). Check-in 2026-04-12, check-out 2026-04-15. Hotel phone +1 415-555-0182.
- Shuttle: hotel -> venue shuttle runs 06:30-22:00. Confirm pickup time for booth load-in.
- Badge pickup: expo hall entrance, allow 20-30 min first day. Bring company ID.

BOOTH / SHIPPING:
- Booth #A12. EventOps contact: Maria Santos (maria@eventops.com) / +1 312-555-0199.
- AV vendor: SoundLight Inc - lead tech: Ken Park (kenp@soundlight.com) / +1 212-555-0113. Confirm mic + projector specs by 2026-03-25.
- Shipping crate (booth materials): UPS tracking 1Z9999... (leave label at front desk) - deliver to venue by 2026-04-10. I already arranged same-day return pickup with UPS (account on Ramp).
- Booth checklist: banners, iPad kiosk, HDMI splitter (x2), power strips (surge), extra ethernet cable (cat6), spare laptop charger, gaffer tape, business cards (200), giveaway stickers (500).

EXPENSE / REIMBURSEMENT NOTES:
- Use corporate card (Ramp) for flights/hotel/AV where possible. If forced to use personal card, upload receipts to Concur within 7 days of expense date.
- Receipt rules: attach PDF/PNG copy of receipt for any charge > $25. For meals, itemized receipt required if > $75.
- Per diem guidance: use meals category unless client entertainment (mark as "entertainment" and list attendees).
- Expense categories (tags for Concur): meals, lodging, transport, shipping, booth-supplies, vendor-services, parking, other.
- Currency: a few vendors billed in USD; check card FX rate. For any EUR charges, capture conversion screenshot from card statement.
- Tax/Invoices: hotel invoice must include company name and address for VAT reclaim (if applicable). Request folio at checkout.
- Deadline: submit all expenses for March/April travel by 2026-04-22 to be included in April close.

PERSONAL REMINDERS / TODOs (me):
- (ASAP) Confirm AV mic type with Ken; ask for lapel + handheld. (due 2026-03-18)
- Send list of booth staff to EventOps (names + badges) - CC Chris. (due 2026-03-20)
- Print shipping labels and double-check crate inventory. (due 2026-04-05)
- Book ground transport for demo hardware to venue (size: small rolling case). Use Lyft XL if corporate policy allows.
- Pack power adapters (US -> EU not needed this time), extra SSD with demo model, encrypted per company policy.

VENDOR CONTACTS (quick list):
- Grand City Hotel - reservations@grandcityhotel.com / +1 415-555-0182 (booking: REDWOOD-42)
- EventOps - Maria Santos (maria@eventops.com) / +1 312-555-0199
- SoundLight Inc (AV) - Ken Park (kenp@soundlight.com) / +1 212-555-0113
- UPS (account rep) - Leo Chen (leo.chen@ups.com) / +1 800-555-0122
- Catering vendor (for private meetup) - BluePlate Events (hello@blueplate.com) / +1 415-555-0177 - tentative headcount 25, menu: boxed lunches (GF/veg options)

MEALS / TEAM DINNER:
- Tentative team dinner: 2026-04-13 19:00 at Harbor Grill (reserve for 12). Contact: Rachel (rachel@harborgrill.com) / +1 415-555-0133. Charge to corporate card and expense under "team-meal"; list attendee names in Concur.

DOCUMENTS / LINKS I NEED TO SAVE: (move to Confluence later)
- Booth layout PDF (attached in Confluence: confluence.redwood/summit-2026-booth-layout)
- Talk slide deck draft - PR in GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/presentations/pull/23
- Expense policy page (finance): confluence.redwood/finance/expense-policy

NOTES FOR OPS / HANDOFF: (if someone else needs to step in)
- Primary contact for day-of logistics: Chris Wu (work +1 415-555-0145). Backup: Laura Chen.
- Key things to confirm night before: AV mic test, internet at booth (static IP vs DHCP), power strips labeled, demo laptops fully charged and locked screen saver disabled.

OTHER QUICK THOUGHTS / SCRATCHES:
- Consider preloading a short demo video loop in case of network outage. Put on an encrypted USB and also on laptop local copy.
- Giveaway suggestion: small notebook + sticker pack (cost around $3 ea). Ask marketing for budget sign-off.

END NOTES:
- Will clean up and create formal runbook in Confluence after 2026-03-18 once AV + final booth staff locked.

Revision history (notes):
- 2026-03-01: initial scratchpad created while coordinating AV + shipping.
- 2026-03-04: added EventOps contact and UPS rep after email thread with Ops.
